purpose: Record-level evidence grading for the TEA cost register. Grades describe the evidence supporting the input value; applicability, uncertainty, source status and cost-boundary limitations remain in tea_cost_register.csv and are not erased by a B grade.

quality_class_definitions.B: A traceable external source reports the benchmark value/range directly. Source type and project transfer limitations must remain visible.
quality_class_definitions.C: The GreenHub cost value is an engineering estimate produced by scaling, selecting a midpoint, combining components, or applying an allowance to source evidence.
quality_class_definitions.E: The specific cost value is an explicit analyst/user assumption without a defensible source value for that amount.
